# Scrollbar tracks (#287)

Open this file in the reader. The scrollbar on the right is drawn below
the tab strip: take its thumb to the top of that track and the page shows
this heading; take it to the foot and the page shows the last section,
without going on into the tab strip. A click on the track centres the
thumb there.

Press **Tab** for the Contents: its 50 headings outgrow the panel, so a
thin bar shows at its right edge. Drag it, or click its track; the
release neither jumps to a heading nor closes the panel. The file
browser (**B**) and the search results (**Ctrl+Shift+F**) have the same
bar. Where a panel's edge resizes it, the bar stays clear of that edge.
